column1: # Source: Hu Y, Taylor-Harding B, Raz Y, Haro M, Recouvreux MS, Taylan E,
#   Lester J, Millstein J, Walts AE, Karlan BY, Orsulic S (2020).
#   "Are Epithelial Ovarian Cancers of the Mesenchymal Subtype Actually
# The authors score a sample by thresholding each gene at its median across
# primary tumours, assigning 1/0, summing the 15 and rescaling to 0-1, where
# 1 = Mes. They report this score tracking fibroblast content in GSE133296
# metastases (r = 0.703 omental, 0.893 non-omental) but not in primary
# ovarian tumours (r = 0.170, ns) -- so it is an expression signature that
# they showed follows stromal content, not a measurement of stroma.
# All 15 are a strict subset of the 100-gene Verhaak Mes set, and every one is
# a collagen / extracellular matrix / fibroblast gene.
